name: Furina
story: Furina, known as Lady Furina, is Fontaine's flamboyant Hydro Archon, a performer whose theatrical persona sits at the heart of the Fontaine story. In a team she works best as a Support, acting as both healer and team-wide buffer, while her Skill doubles as her main source of damage.
source: Game8 Furina guide; Game8 and PocketGamer tier lists (Oct 2026)

name: Nahida
story: Nahida, the Physic of Purity and Lesser Lord Kusanali, was freed from long confinement in the Sanctuary of Surasthana and now steps into a stronger role in Sumeru. In a team she is a top Dendro Sub-DPS and Support, marking up to 8 enemies with her Skill and bringing high-frequency Dendro application.
source: Game8 Nahida guide; Genshin Impact Wiki; tier lists (Oct 2026)

name: Raiden Shogun
story: The Raiden Shogun is the vessel of Raiden Ei, Inazuma's Electro Archon, who isolated herself in the Plane of Euthymia. On the field she plays as an Electro Burst DPS or Sub-DPS, bringing extra Energy Recharge to the team and hitting hard on demand with her Burst.
source: Game8 Raiden Shogun guide; Genshin Impact Wiki; tier lists (Oct 2026)

name: Zhongli
story: Zhongli is the Geo Archon Morax, walking Liyue under a mortal name as a consultant for the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. He is the near-uncontested Shielder Support, building the sturdiest shields in the game with potential as a Geo Burst DPS.

name: Xiao
story: Xiao is the last surviving member of the Five Yakshas that Morax sent to subdue Liyue's demonic spirits, and he still guards the region. He plays as a Main DPS, powering up his plunging attacks with a Burst that drains his HP while it is active.
source: Game8 Xiao guide; Genshin Impact Wiki; tier lists (Oct 2026)

name: Hu Tao
story: Hu Tao is the 77th Director of Liyue's Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. She is a high-risk, high-reward Pyro Trigger DPS who spends her own HP for damage, shining in Vaporize or Melt teams and benefiting most from two Hydro units.
source: Game8 Hu Tao guide; Genshin Impact Wiki; tier lists (Oct 2026)

name: Kazuha
story: Kazuha is a wandering samurai from Inazuma's Kaedehara Clan who fled the country as a wanted man and found shelter with Beidou's crew. Swirl Support is his best role, with his Elemental Mastery boosting the whole party's elemental damage whenever he Swirls.
source: Game8 Kazuha guide; Genshin Impact Wiki; tier lists (Oct 2026)

name: Ganyu
story: Ganyu is an Adeptus who serves as secretary to the Liyue Qixing and, in Zhongli's words, has served the Geo Archon longer than anyone else. She is a sustained Cryo DPS that Melts or Freezes with Charged Attacks, and can also work as an off-field Sub-DPS in Dendro and Fridge teams.

name: Neuvillette
story: Neuvillette, the Ordainer of Inexorable Judgment, is the Chief Justice of the Court of Fontaine. He plays as a hypercarry Main DPS whose HP-scaling Charged Attack lets him hover and blast while the team is built around buffing him.

name: Venti
story: Venti is a wine-loving bard of Mondstadt and the mortal vessel of Barbatos, the Anemo Archon. On the field he is a Sub-DPS staple for Freeze, Hyperbloom and Rainbow teams, grouping enemies together and Swirling Cryo for the party.
source: Game8 Venti guide; Genshin Impact Wiki; tier lists (Oct 2026)

name: Arlecchino
story: Arlecchino is a Fatui Harbinger who was pardoned by the Tsaritsa and took over the House of the Hearth as its "Father". She is a Pyro Main DPS and a prime candidate for Melt teams, consuming marks to gain Bond of Life that empowers her attacks.

name: Mavuika
story: Mavuika is Natlan's current Pyro Archon. She flexes as a Pyro Main DPS or Sub-DPS, playing on-field as a damage carry or off-field as a Pyro applicator, with a Burst charged by Fighting Spirit instead of Energy.

name: Skirk
story: Skirk is a mysterious swordswoman and disciple of Surtalogi who trained Tartaglia in the Abyss after he fell in, teaching him much of what he knows. As a Cryo Main DPS she works best in Freeze teams, powering her Burst with Serpent's Subtlety from her Skill.
source: Game8 Skirk guide; Genshin Impact Wiki; tier lists (Oct 2026)
